title: Proper-flat canonical open-square mate invertibility
statement: Let f:X→Y be a proper, flat, locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], with Y quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Fix derived module categories for every scheme in one universe [def-pc-derived-category], and an affine open W of Y. Write X_W=X×_Y W [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let a and b be any right adjoints to the canonical lifts of Rf_* and R(f_W)_* to the quasi-coherent derived categories, with supplied adjunctions [def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Suppose the canonical ordinary derived base-change map for this pullback square is an isomorphism on every quasi-coherent derived input [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For each K in D_QCoh(Y), the canonical duality mate L(j_X)^*a(K)→b(Lj^*K) [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map] is an isomorphism. Here j:W→Y is the open inclusion and j_X:X_W→X the first projection. Neither Y nor X is assumed affine; empty W and all unbounded K are allowed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Duality for Schemes and Cohomology of Sheaves

proof.text: Exact open restriction agrees with derived pullback: identify tensor pullback with module restriction by uniqueness of its left adjunction and use uniqueness of the left-derived functor. The open pullback is identified with f inverse(W) by its two projections. The affine open and its proper inverse image are quasi-compact.

Apply proper_flat_rightAdjoint_restriction_open to the canonical lift of Rf_* and to an identity base-change square. Its first clause makes restriction of a applied to the open unit invertible, for every unbounded K. The open direct-image preserves quasi-coherent cohomology, so that the unit target is in the required full subcategory.

Direct-image restriction and composition give the invertible conjugate comparison a Rj_* ≅ Ri_* b. Under the chosen adjunctions the canonical mate is exactly restricted a of the unit, followed by restriction of the inverse conjugate, followed by the open counit. The last two maps are isomorphisms: the conjugate is invertible by the assumed ordinary base change, and open direct image is fully faithful. Transport across the projection isomorphism and uniqueness of right adjoints to the supplied b and adjunction. Thus the full mate is invertible, including for empty W.

theorem proper_flat_openSquare_mate_isIso
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (W : Y.Opens) [IsAffine W.toScheme]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory W.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f W.ι))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty W.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f W.ι)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f W.ι)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f W.ι)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f W.ι) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f W.ι) W.ι (pullback.fst f W.ι)
        pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) :
    IsIso (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y W.toScheme
      (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
      f W.ι a a' adjf adjf' hβ K)
